title: Delayed Express Delivery Refund
conditions: Order was shipped using Express delivery
Delivery is delayed by 2 or more days
Customer has not already received a refund
action: Customer is eligible for a full shipping fee refund.

title: Delayed Standard Delivery
conditions: Order was shipped using Standard delivery
Delivery is delayed by 5 or more days
action: Customer may be eligible for compensation after review.

title: Product Damage Refund
conditions: Customer reports the issue within 7 days
action: Customer is eligible for a product refund after verification.

title: Order Cancellation
conditions: Order has not entered final delivery stage
